cases.rationale: The slenderness ratio length/height = 2 is far below the validated minimum of 10, so shear deformation dominates and the instrument's entire validation basis (convergence to the Euler-Bernoulli closed form) is the wrong reference and voided here, with no diagnostic to catch it.
cases.right_instrument: a 3D elasticity FE solve (the same C3D8I model is physically capable of a stubby beam) but validated against a Timoshenko/full-3D reference rather than Euler-Bernoulli; as-validated it does not cover this regime — route to human/real experiment

cases.rationale: The linearity ratio tip_deflection/length is ~15 percent, exceeding the 0.10 validity limit, so the linear small-deflection solve ignores geometric stiffening and returns a physically wrong deflection.

At nu=0.4999 the C3D8I elements suffer volumetric locking that artificially stiffens the beam and corrupts tip_displacement, and no diagnostic detects it, so the number is numerically suspect rather than a faithful measurement.
cases.right_instrument: a near-incompressibility-robust FE formulation using hybrid/mixed u-p elements (e.g. C3D8H) in place of C3D8I

cases.rationale: The requested QoI is max_von_mises, whose pointwise maximum sits on the clamped-corner stress singularity and diverges under mesh refinement rather than converging, so the instrument's number is a meshing artifact, not a physical stress.
